name: hubplanner
description: Reads Hubplanner scheduling, project, resource, client, billing, time, vacation, custom-field, and webhook-subscription data and exposes typed reverse-ETL writes for documented Hubplanner REST resources.

risk.read: external Hubplanner API reads of scheduling, project, resource, client, time, vacation, billing, and webhook-subscription data
